quote: There was a post that the president of El Salvador put out. And he pretty much just said like this, hey, we want to help thousands of dogs and cats live in our streets. And we want to change that, but without cruelty, we have the financial resources, but we seek expert partners to make it a model for Latin America. And I will just tell you right now that the way this is actually possible as far as them actually having the financial resources was their investment into Bitcoin.
